A document cached at time 100 with TTL 10 must be unavailable at time 110 and afterwards, and expired entries must be removed. Before the deadline, return its value without changing its expiration; overwriting a key starts the new TTL. Verify the DocumentService cache path as well.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. Finish with a brief description and the tests you ran.
